specials:
Generals, Wizards and Heroes may ride Griffons. The Griffon combines the appearance of a lion and an eagle. These creatures are hatched from stolen eggs and hand-reared to serve as mounts for favoured individuals. A unit which includes a Griffon causes terror in its enemies.
